title: Vulnerability Management Analyst
description:
**ob Title:** Vulnerability Management Analyst  

  

**What you will do:**  

The Vulnerability Management Analyst will play a crucial role in our organization by managing and mitigating vulnerabilities across our systems and networks. You will be responsible for identifying, analyzing, and reporting vulnerabilities, coordinating remediation efforts, and ensuring compliance with security policies and regulations.  

  

**How you will do it:**

* Conduct regular vulnerability assessments and scans to identify potential security weaknesses.
* Analyze and prioritize vulnerabilities based on risk and impact to the organization.
* Collaborate with IT and security teams to develop and implement remediation plans.
* Maintain up\-to\-date documentation of vulnerabilities and remediation efforts.
* Assist in the development of security policies and procedures related to vulnerability management.
* Stay informed about the latest security threats, vulnerabilities, and best practices in the field.
* Support incident response efforts as needed.

 **What we look for:**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.
* 4\-8 years of experience in vulnerability management, security analysis, or a related field.
* Familiarity with vulnerability scanning tools (e.g., Nessus, Qualys, Rapid7\).
* Basic understanding of network and application security concepts.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
* Security certifications (e.g., CompTIA Security\+, CEH) are a plus.

 **Our culture:**  

At JCI, we value diversity and inclusion and strive to create a supportive and collaborative workplace. Join us to make an impact in the field of cybersecurity and contribute to the safety and security of our organization and clients.

title: Apps Dev Tech Lead Analyst - Vice President
description:

**Job Overview**
----------------


The Applications Development Lead Analyst is responsible for leading the design, development, modernization, and support of enterprise applications while driving technical strategy, engineering excellence, and delivery across multiple initiatives. title: Senior Analyst, Risk Management
description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**


Senior Analyst, Risk Management
Senior Analyst, IT Risk Management – Individual Contributor  

  

Overview  

  

The Senior Analyst, IT Risk Management, will support our SOX Compliance program within the Finance Organization and will report into the US\-based Manager, Risk Management. This position will primarily focus on scoping and evaluation of general and application IT controls. The Senior Analyst will be responsible for managing and executing various aspects of the program including IT scoping, delivery of the program, and reporting of results. The Senior Analyst will work closely with the US\-based SOX team, worldwide IT departments, regional controllership, our shared services center, business owners, and our internal and external auditors, with the expectation of some overlap in the working hours.  

  

Requirements for this position include extensive knowledge of IT general and application controls, strong understanding of IT control frameworks (e.g., COBIT, NIST Cybersecurity, NIST SP 800\-53, CIS/SANS Top 20\), familiarity with SEC/PCAOB regulations, COSO and US GAAP, as well as the demonstrated ability to monitor an effective global risk\-based IT control environment.  

  

* Are you looking to join a fast\-paced, collaborative environment supporting a world class growing organization?
* Do you have the ability to think strategically and execute a complex project?
* Do you have a risk\-based mindset?
* Are you IT savvy?
* Do you have the ability to drive change and improve awareness across the organization?

  

Role  

  

Job Description  

* Support the execution of various SOX program components, including IT scoping, IT risk assessment, training of stakeholders on IT control\-related best practices, IT control testing and review, remediation recommendations, deficiency evaluations and reporting
* Report to a US\-based Manager, Risk Management
* Assess and determine design effectiveness of internal controls
* Experience covering multiple technology environments such as Mainframe, UNIX/Linux, Cloud and Windows environments
* Work with business owners to address any potential control gaps that may require remediation
* Partner with various business owners and IT teams including technology compliance, operations, development, and application support to provide expertise in assessing the design and effectiveness of IT controls
* Liaise with regional finance and IT stakeholders as well as internal and external auditors
* Ensure the delivery of high quality, timely work products
* Continuously identify efficiencies in the SOX program and opportunities for optimization of the financial and operational processes and controls through interaction and partnership with management
* Exhibit strong project management skills with the ability to hold self and others accountable to internal and external deadlines
* Ability to effectively manage international time\-zone differences in communication globally
* Demonstrate the ability to exercise judgment and display a high standard of ethics and professionalism
* Demonstrate exceptional communications skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to understand complexities of the business

  

All About You  

* Bachelor Degree Accounting, Business, Management Information Systems or equivalent, a CPA/CA, CISA or similar certification required
* Has a strong understanding of IT control concepts and framework such as COBIT, NIST Cybersecurity, NIST SP 800\-53, CIS/SANS Top 20, Sarbanes Oxley, COSO, and leading business practices
* Recent experience providing IT auditing or IT advisory\-type services
* Knowledge of best practices around IT controls
* Working knowledge of current PCAOB Auditing and Accounting Standards
* Experience with the IT external audit or risk advisory services or an in\-house Technology Risk Management (first/second line of defense) or equivalent experience in a large, regulated organization with exposure to both infrastructure and applications
* Knowledge of common enterprise and web application technologies
* Familiarity with audit automation preferred
* Proven ability to manage complex engagements or programs
* Excellent oral and written communication skills and interpersonal skills with emphasis on building strong, longer\-term relationships worldwide across varying geographies and functions
* Detail oriented, self\-motivated with the ability to meet project deadlines and deliverables in a fast\-paced environment
* Experience in risk management field (e.g., risk management, audit, compliance) desired
* Effective ability to influence, drive change and resolve conflicts
* Strong analytic, logical reasoning and problem\-solving skills
* Strong project management skills to lead and prioritize multiple projects
* Demonstrated ability to drive change and continuous improvement
* Some travel may be required in the future, up to 10% travel

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

  

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Actuarial Analyst
description:
**Actuarial Analyst – Assurant India**

The Actuarial Analyst will be responsible for evaluating, underwriting, and managing reinsurance risks in line with the branch's underwriting strategy, risk appetite, and regulatory requirements. The role will support profitable business growth while ensuring compliance with IFSCA regulations, internal underwriting guidelines, and group policies applicable to the Foreign Reinsurance Branch operating as an IFSC Insurance Office (IIO).


**Location: GIFT City, Gandhinagar, Gujarat (IFSC)**  

  



**Key Responsibilities**

* Assess, evaluate, and approve facultative and treaty reinsurance risks in line with approved underwriting guidelines, delegated authority limits, and risk appetite.
* Develop, maintain, and periodically review pricing models, risk selection criteria, underwriting frameworks, and exposure management standards.
* Ensure adherence to approved risk appetite, underwriting governance requirements, accumulation controls, and exposure limits.
* Work closely with brokers, cedants, and business partners to support business development, client retention, and profitable portfolio growth.
* Monitor portfolio performance, loss ratios, claims trends, premium adequacy, and overall underwriting profitability.
* Coordinate with actuarial, risk management, and finance teams to assess pricing adequacy, portfolio performance, reserving trends, and capital implications.
* Review submissions, exposure data, claims history, and market information to determine appropriate pricing, terms, conditions, and capacity deployment.
* Negotiate reinsurance contract terms, coverage conditions, exclusions, and pricing with cedants and intermediaries.
* Ensure documentation quality, contract certainty, and compliance with international reinsurance practices, regulatory requirements, and internal policies.
* Maintain accurate underwriting records, risk assessments, and management information systems.
* Monitor catastrophe exposures, concentration risks, and portfolio accumulations to ensure effective risk management.
* Ensure compliance with IFSCA regulations, internal underwriting policies, sanctions requirements, AML obligations, and applicable governance standards applicable to IIO operations.
* Provide regular portfolio analysis, underwriting reports, and performance updates to the Principal Officer and parent entity (VSC).
* Provide insights and recommendations to the Principal Officer regarding market developments, competitive dynamics, emerging risks, reinsurance pricing trends, and underwriting strategy.
* Support regulatory reporting, audits, inspections, and information requests from IFSCA and other relevant authorities.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with cedants, brokers, reinsurers, and other market participants to support the branch's strategic objectives.

**What are the requirements needed for this position?**

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Actuarial Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field
* Associate or near Associate of a recognized actuarial body (e.g., SOA, CAS, IFoA, CIA or equivalent).

**Experience**

* Minimum of 8 years of overall experience.
* Minimum of 8 years of progressive responsibilities in an actuarial role, including leading projects, processes, and staff.
  

  

If no application deadline is provided, this role may be a pipeline requisition, and we'll continue to collect applications on an ongoing basis, or there is no requirement for this information in the location where the role is posted.


Any posted pay range considers a wide range of compensation factors, including candidate background, experience, and work location, while also allowing for salary growth within the position.

title: Senior Associate, Cyber Security Disputes & Investigations
description:
**Description**


**Job Description: Senior Associate, Cyber Security Disputes \& Investigations**

**Overview**


Alvarez \& Marsal, a leading independent global professional services firm, specializing in providing turnaround management, performance improvement, and corporate advisory services, is seeking to expand its Disputes \& Investigations team. With more than 7,000 professionals based in 75\+ locations across 30\+ countries in North America, Europe, Asia, and Latin America, our firm excels in problem\-solving and value creation. Drawing on a strong operational heritage and hands\-on approach, our professionals work closely with organizations and stakeholders to help tackle complex business issues and maximize value.

**The Position**


As a **Senior Associate** within A\&M's Cybersecurity practice in the Disputes \& Investigations group, you will play a key role in delivering cybersecurity, privacy, risk, and AI governance engagements across diverse industries. You will work directly with clients to assess cybersecurity posture, identify risks, develop remediation roadmaps, and support implementation of security and governance frameworks.


The successful candidate will contribute to and independently execute engagements involving:

**Cybersecurity Program Maturity Assessments**

* Evaluate cybersecurity programs against industry frameworks including ISO 27001, NIST CSF, CIS Controls, COBIT, and other regulatory requirements.
* Assess governance structures, security operating models, policies, standards, and controls.
* Develop maturity assessments, gap analyses, and improvement roadmaps.

**IT Risk \& Security Assessments**

* Lead cybersecurity risk assessments across applications, infrastructure, cloud environments, and third\-party ecosystems.
* Perform security reviews, data classification exercises, and control effectiveness assessments.
* Identify cybersecurity risks and provide practical mitigation recommendations.

**Data Privacy \& Regulatory Compliance**

* Conduct privacy assessments against DPDPA, GDPR, ISO 27701, and other applicable regulations.
* Support development and implementation of privacy governance frameworks, policies, and operating procedures.
* Assist clients in privacy program enhancement, data lifecycle reviews, and compliance readiness initiatives.

**AI Security \& Governance**

* Assess AI systems for security, privacy, governance, and compliance risks.
* Support implementation of AI governance frameworks, risk management practices, and responsible AI controls.
* Evaluate controls related to GenAI solutions, model governance, data protection, and regulatory requirements.

**Security Awareness \& Cyber Culture**

* Design and deliver cybersecurity and privacy awareness initiatives.
* Develop training content, phishing simulation programs, and executive awareness sessions.
* Support clients in building sustainable cyber risk awareness programs.

**Cybersecurity Architecture \& Technical Reviews**

* Participate in security assessments across cloud, infrastructure, application security, identity and access management, and data security domains.
* Review technical controls and architectures against security best practices and industry standards.
* Identify gaps and recommend improvements aligned to organizational risk appetite.

**Research \& Thought Leadership**

* Monitor emerging cybersecurity threats, industry trends, AI security developments, and evolving regulatory requirements.
* Contribute to thought leadership, methodologies, accelerators, and market\-facing content.

 **Role and Responsibilities**

**Client Delivery**

* Independently execute cybersecurity, privacy, and governance engagements with minimal supervision.
* Conduct stakeholder interviews, workshops, control assessments, and documentation reviews.
* Analyze findings, prioritize risks, and develop actionable recommendations.
* Prepare high\-quality client reports, presentations, and executive briefings.

**Project Management**

* Manage workstreams and deliverables while ensuring quality and adherence to timelines.
* Coordinate with client stakeholders and internal teams to drive project execution.
* Support proposal development, scoping activities, and business development efforts.

**Team Leadership \& Collaboration**

* Mentor Analysts and Associates through technical guidance and quality reviews.
* Foster collaboration across multidisciplinary teams.
* Contribute to capability building, knowledge sharing, and practice development initiatives.

**Business Development Support**

* Contribute to proposal preparation, market research, and solution development.
* Participate in client meetings, workshops, and networking activities.

**Continuous Learning**

* Stay current on cybersecurity, AI governance, privacy regulations, and industry best practices.
* Pursue relevant professional certifications and technical skill development.

 **The Requirements**

**Education \& Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Security, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 4\-6 years of relevant cybersecurity consulting, risk advisory, or information security experience.
* Experience delivering cybersecurity assessments, governance reviews, privacy initiatives, or compliance programs.

**Technical Competencies**

**Cybersecurity Governance \& Risk**

* Strong understanding of cybersecurity frameworks and standards including: ISO 27001, NIST CSF, CIS Controls, ISO 22301, ISO 27701

**AI Security \& Governance**

* Understanding of AI governance frameworks, AI risk management principles, and responsible AI practices.
* Awareness of emerging AI security risks including model security, prompt injection, adversarial attacks, and data privacy concerns.

**Data Privacy \& Compliance**

* Experience working with DPDPA, GDPR, ISO 27701, or similar privacy regulations and standards.
* Knowledge of privacy impact assessments and data protection controls.

 **Preferred Certifications**


One or more of the following certifications are preferred: CISSP, CISA, CISM, Certified Data Privacy Professional (CIPP)

 **Soft Skills**

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Excellent report writing and presentation skills.
* Ability to communicate effectively with technical and executive stakeholders.
* Strong stakeholder management and client\-facing skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced consulting environment.
* Demonstrated ownership, accountability, and attention to detail.

 **Language**

* Fluent written and verbal communication in English.

title: Playwright automation
description:
Job Summary
  
Execute and document test cases across asset classes (Securities FX Derivatives OTCs etc) and applications.
  
**Skills:** Hands\-on test execution deep product knowledge experience with test management tools strong analytical skills.
  
  

Responsibilities
  
Lead comprehensive test planning for web services and API platforms by defining scope objectives entry criteria exit criteria and detailed timelines aligned with business priorities and project milestones.
  
Oversee design and documentation of test scenarios and test cases for REST API and SOAP services ensuring coverage for functional behavior integration flows edge conditions error handling and performance related validations.
  
Coordinate test execution across system and integration test cycles using Postman SoapUI and other API tools to validate request and response structures status codes headers payload transformations and downstream impacts.
  
Drive SQL based data validation by designing queries that verify data correctness referential integrity reconciliation rules and transaction posting across multiple schemas and environments used by investment banking operations platforms.
  
Manage defect lifecycle using Jira by logging defects with clear reproduction steps technical context priority and severity and by tracking investigation resolution retesting and closure in alignment with agreed service levels.
  
Collaborate with developers business analysts and operations stakeholders to clarify requirements refine acceptance criteria and resolve ambiguities impacting test design for trading settlement and reference data workflows.
  
Provide risk based testing recommendations by identifying high impact services complex integrations and critical data paths and by proposing targeted test sets that optimize effort while safeguarding key business outcomes.
  
Ensure adherence to organizational quality standards by enforcing test entry and exit gates reviewing test evidence and maintaining structured documentation for audits compliance checks and knowledge transfer.
  
Guide automation ready test design by defining reusable test data parameterized inputs and verifiable outputs that can support future automation initiatives for regression and smoke testing of APIs and web services.
  
Monitor test progress and environment readiness by preparing daily status updates highlighting blockers and dependencies and coordinating with environment teams to address configuration connectivity or data related issues.
  
Align test activities with investment banking operations needs by focusing on scenarios such as trade booking lifecycle events settlements confirmations and reporting to ensure reliability and consistency of operational flows.
  
Support production readiness through structured regression cycles sanity checks and post release validation of critical services thereby reducing incidents and improving stability for end users and operations teams.
  
Contribute to continuous improvement by capturing lessons learned refining test processes proposing better use of Jira and API tools and mentoring team members on test design SQL techniques and domain understanding.
  
  

Qualifications
  
Possess strong hands on experience in Jira for test management and defect tracking demonstrating ability to configure workflows create dashboards and provide analytics that improve visibility and decision making.
  
Exhibit deep technical skills in web services testing and API testing using Postman and SoapUI including validation of REST endpoints SOAP operations authentication flows and complex JSON and XML payloads.
  
Demonstrate solid proficiency in SQL by writing complex joins subqueries and aggregation queries to verify transactional data reconcile records and troubleshoot defects across multiple data stores.
  
Show practical experience in testing REST API based architectures including understanding of resource modeling versioning strategies pagination error models and compatibility considerations across environments.
  
Bring advantageous exposure to investment banking operations such as trade lifecycle settlements reconciliations and regulatory reporting enabling richer test coverage and better alignment with business risks.
  
Display capability to work independently in a work from office day shift model coordinating with cross functional teams on site while managing priorities across parallel projects without requiring travel.
  
  

Certifications Required
  
Preferred certifications such as ISTQB Advanced Test Analyst or API Testing related certification from recognized professional bodies good ot have.

title: Cybersecurity Analyst
description:
**Company Description**  

At Smiths we apply leading\-edge technology to design, manufacture and deliver smarter engineering solutions for mission\-critical applications, solving some of the world's toughest problems for our customers, our communities and our world. We are a FTSE100, global business of around 15,000 colleagues, based in 50 countries.


Our solutions have a real impact on lives across the planet, enabling industry, improving healthcare, enhancing security, advancing connectivity, and supporting new homes. Our products and services are often critical to our customers’ operations, while our proprietary technology and high service levels help create competitive advantage. We welcome colleagues with a curious mind, who are happy with responsibility, enjoy a challenge and are attracted by the idea of working at a business with an almost 170\-year history of innovation, and four global divisions, all experts in their field.

 **Job Description** **Job Roles and Responsibilities:**


This role is responsible for daily and real\-time monitoring of cyber security tooling and environments and the provision of Level I and II cyber security incident management to include: Detection and Analysis, Containment, Eradication, Recovery, Reporting, and Remediation. (Triage, Incident Handling and Threat Hunting)


In addition to monitoring and incident management, the position is responsible for providing cyber security subject matter expertise, service management, and hands on administration of advanced cyber security tooling as assigned. Specific service management and administration assignments will vary by individual and may include services such as System Information \& Event and Management (SIEM), Vulnerability and Patch Management, Data Leakage Protection, User Rights Management, Conditional Access or CASB, Application Whitelisting, Firewall management, and Anti\-Malware.


The position also supports road mapping, projects and risk assessments, policy management, reporting, and cross\-training.


This role will require working within the Security Operations Centre (SOC) and requires flexibility across all times zones as it involves engagement with colleagues from all locations of the global business.

 **Responsibilities:**

* Monitor cyber information, events, alerts, and ticketing queues to identify security events and threats across multiple technologies to ensure security incidents are identified timely
* Proactively research and maintain a proficiency in current and emerging threats, vulnerabilities and security technology developments
* Evaluate and utilize intelligence for new threats and vulnerabilities to ensure protective monitoring capable of detecting potential new attacks
* Provide assurance of security posture through monitoring security system status
* Respond to tickets and incidents as assigned
* Support the incident and problem response process through to closure.
* Act as Level II SME escalation; work with internal and external individuals in preparation and when necessary, remediation/suppression
* Support, maintain, and tune security tooling and systems as assigned
* Support and maintain operational procedures and documentation
* Ensure timely accurate communications of alerts to stakeholders responding to escalations, or will escalate if required as per the agreed processes
* Work collaboratively with BIS teams to position information security as a key enabler within each service area
* Make recommendations of counter\-measures, mitigating controls, best practice configuration and processes to improve operational effectiveness and efficiency within security operations Proactively support the secure delivery of BIS strategies and delivery objectives

 **Qualifications**  

* Minimum four\-year degree specific to information/cyber security or equivalent experience
* Minimum\-4 Years to Maximum 6 Years experience.
* Additional minimum 2\+ years hands\-on firewall administration – preferably in a SOC environment
* Professional information security certifications such as CompTIA Security\+, CEH, GIAC, CISSP, CISM, CCNA Security, CCNP Security or CISA required
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to engage with a variety of different people
* Strong analytical skills and problem\-solving capabilities with attention to detail
* Ability to work well with others, with an emphasis on virtual teams across multiple time zones
* Recognize and respond to potential, successful, and unsuccessful cyber\-attacks and compromises thorough reviews and analysis of relevant event detail
* Subject matter expertise in multiple security technologies and across the cyber security body of knowledge

  

**Additional Information**  

We recognise that no candidate is likely to meet every requirement listed. If your experience and skills aligns with the behaviours we’re looking for and many of the skills and responsibilities outlined, we would encourage you to apply.
